name: Hometown Trap
source:
Have you ever felt like you were trapped in your own hometown? Well this is a story about several girls who find themselves stuck in their hometown with no ability to escape. You will follow their lives and see what situations they must face on a day to day basis.

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/hometown-trap-v1-5-spaceball1.106606/]F95Zone[/url]]
translation:
你是否曾覺得，自己被困在了故鄉？這個故事講述的，正是幾個困在家鄉、無力逃離的女孩。你將跟隨她們的生活，瞭解她們每天不得不面對的種種境遇。

[摘自[url=https://f95zone.to/threads/hometown-trap-v1-5-spaceball1.106606/]F95Zone[/url]]
